title: Hosted plugin block rejection is observable at the graph boundary

needles: SignalGraph routed hosted failure is terminal and fail-closed
Legacy graph fallback contains a hosted failure to one invocation

installed_sdk.rationale: The crossfade slot inherits the append-only PluginSlot status boundary and forwards per-block rejection state. The installed host headers therefore expose the compatible status contract to SDK subclasses, while the graph remains responsible for containment.

live_product_control.rationale: Failure containment is an execution guarantee, not a musician-facing control operation.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The status latch is a runtime hosting boundary and does not add a design-time capability key.
